description: 平成28年熊本地震・DEM/微地形表現図/グラウンドデータ(林野庁加工) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 林野庁. 平成28年熊本地震の発災後に林野庁が実施した航空レーザ測量データを基に、林野庁が作成したDEM（Digital Elevation Model）、PNG標高タイル、TerrainRGB、CS立体図、グラウンドデータです。 TIFF画像（GeoTIFF）、ラスタのXYZタイル（Webp、PNG標高タイル、TerrainRGB）、テキストもし... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 林野庁. It offers 56 resource(s) in 7z, application/x-7z-compressed, gpkg, pdf, qlr. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
